must: Show guest context, current commitments and feasible choices together
Distinguish proposed work from verified updates and physical completion
Keep simulated data and external-action boundaries clear
avoid: Judging guests by age, profession or the moral value of their stories
Suggesting a booking or purchase was completed when it is only a preview

decisions.decision: Guest request leads into a connected plan, with room readiness and guest choices visible before action.
decisions.reason: Show the effect of each stay on the whole property and make context-specific options understandable at a glance.

decisions.decision: Primary navigation is an interactive translucent isometric property cutaway with room actions, unified inbound requests and connected resource counters.
decisions.reason: Human request on 2026-10-28: operate the property as simply as a hospitality game; make the effects of guest choice visible on rooms and work.

decisions.decision: Expand the property to a 36-room, six-floor translucent cutaway with six bed layouts, window-view colors, elevator routes, facility cues and record-driven occupant/work/maintenance animation. Add focused floors, type/status filters, pause motion and mobile horizontal floor navigation.
decisions.reason: 2026-10-28 human request: at least 30 rooms with individual spatial traits and operational state, and connected downstream work.

decisions.decision: Use actual Three.js orbit geometry, front-facing labels and focused floors; show a five-stage dependency ripple with deterministic before/after values and a separate isolated hackathon director.
decisions.reason: Latest user request: genuinely dimensional hotel plus request/change-to-operations animation and exception-only owner intervention.

decisions.decision: Oceanfront 3D command room, source-labelled actionable inbox, persistent per-channel automation rules and reviewable outbound jobs. Immersive mode keeps requests, operations and channels in the scene dock.
decisions.reason: 2026-10-28 direct user request for coastal views, game-like recommended actions, platform automation and immersive control.

decisions.decision: Unfold both hotel wings by default, select room volumes with whole-room outlines, and use a persistent Tasks / Inbox / Rooms control desk. Replace layers with status filters; add distinct animated staff and current-KST lighting.
decisions.reason: 2026-10-29 user asks for immediately selectable rear rooms, clear vacancies, visible staff work, stable rendering and serious tycoon-like controls.

decisions.decision: Remove Open hotel; keep one compact building with all36 fixed facade room controls. Use shared graphic state symbols and physical props; fill selected room surfaces with cyan and link to its fixed icon.
decisions.reason: Direct user correction on2026-10-29: building default, no disappearing labels or tooltip cards, visual differentiation of all operational states.

decisions.decision: Add AI Plan with joint guest alternatives, grounded recovery review, actual inference evidence and multi-room dependency routes inside the existing compact-building desk.
decisions.reason: 2026-10-29 request to connect verified Nemotron calls, multi-guest allocation, operational recovery, measurable costs and a complete 3D hackathon demo.

decisions.decision: Default Agent desk with bounded owner policy, exception-only decision cards, collapsed automatic history and explicit before/after incident reasons on the3D hotel. Preserve warm moss tokens, fixed room controls and meaningful resource routes.
decisions.reason: 2026-10-29 user requests autonomous handling of absence, linen shortages and sudden changes, with only judgment calls escalated.

decisions.decision: Preserve compact building and right control desk; add protected-current versus proposed stay comparison, explicit guest choice and date-specific operating ripples.
decisions.reason: 2026-10-29 customer-agent date, room and party changes must be understandable before and after commitment.

decisions.decision: Add a compact multi-guest coordination desk alongside owner exceptions, with visible new/change provenance, alternative combinations, per-customer selection states and aggregate3D resource routes.
decisions.reason: 2026-10-29 simultaneous customer-agent requests should be understandable without exposing routine waiting as owner work.

decisions.decision: Owner conversation plus live property context becomes the default. Calendar groups rooms by type; 3D is an optional view. Mobile toggles conversation/property; tablet keeps both.
decisions.reason: Direct user direction 2026-10-30: off-site hospitality operations agent, simpler than the game-like control desk.

decisions.decision: Keep booking clarification, compact fact review, coordinated alternatives, explicit guest role and saved operating receipts inside owner conversation. Retain optional property/3D view.
decisions.reason: 2026-10-30 direct request: complete mobile natural-language request through customer choice and operations without legacy input-screen handoffs.
